column1: # 1D inject sweep at the current compiled defaults: slope=425, floor=80 fixed,
# --inject in {6,8,10,12,15}. Isolates the additive-injection knob with the
# multiplicative transfer held constant (the slope x floor grid could not: along
# its slope axis, transfer magnitude and injection frequency move together).
# At slope=425/floor=80 an init-weight source transfers w = 0.425*(100-80) = 8.5,
# which is below inject for N>=10 (sink gets max(w,N)=N, net +N-8.5) and at/below
# for N=8 (knife-edge near w), and ABOVE for N=6 (w>N -> conservative, no inject).
# So this ladder straddles the inject-fires / inject-dormant boundary: N=6 is
# (mostly) conservative, N=8 sits on the edge, N=10/12/15 inject with growing
# top-up. inject=10 is the compiled default (the anchor).
# slope and floor are pinned explicitly so inject is the only variable.
